title: Vim and the Workbench say what they need
steps: On a phone, Vim is off: Extensions › Vim says "Off on this device · needs a keyboard". With a Bluetooth keyboard, press Escape in a note: Vim starts there at once.

On a laptop, Split right (⌘⇧P). Narrow the window below 840px: one window shows and the other is kept. Below 600px the tab bar goes too, and ⌘⇧P greys Split right with "needs a screen 840px wide". Widen it: both windows are back.
Open this Preview in a private window: it starts from your laptop's layout. Open it with ?device=phone: it starts with just the note on show.
Without a keyboard (?device=phone), ⌘⇧P lists no shortcuts beside commands.
